cpsFeature.note: Platform BEHAVIOR of the embedded demo is governed by chrome-platform-showcase's own immutable conformance contract at conformanceRoute. gendn references it and does not fork or contradict its assertions.

assertions.describe: The stable route /v151/textstream-for-response-request-blob/ responds 200 (durable-demo contract).
Page carries its canonical chromestatus.com/feature/5146752165478400 link — the immutable feature identity (CLAUDE.md invariant #3) and the milestone-151 mapping's self-heal.
Document has a non-empty <title> for the reference page.
Exactly one <h1> — the API name (listing name), MDN-shaped article heading.
A single <main> landmark wraps the article content.
Shared editorial design system /public/styles.css is linked.
Responsive viewport meta present (width=device-width) for mobile+desktop parity.
Breadcrumb links back to the /v151/ release index.
Byline footer present (article provenance).
Every target=_blank link carries rel=noopener (no reverse-tabnabbing; MDN-style external link hygiene).
No anchor has an empty or placeholder (#) href.
assertions.test: [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].every(el => { const h = el.getAttribute('href'); return h && h !== '#'; })

assertions.describe: Page loads with no console errors.
No failed (>=400 / net-error) network requests on load.
No unintended horizontal overflow at desktop (1280x800).
No unintended horizontal overflow at narrow mobile (360x740, DPR3).
Desktop render is legible, contrast passes WCAG AA, controls/text not clipped (screenshot review).
Mobile render is legible with adequate tap targets and no clipped text/controls (screenshot review).
The <h1> is the chromestatus milestone-listing name for this feature (not the broader detail name) — factual/source fidelity.
Frontend implementation consulted modern-web-guidance for its UI/responsive/a11y topics and applied or justified them (recorded in _questions.json guidanceConsulted).
Built reference has at least three <h2> sections (MDN-shaped depth).
Cross-browser support is documented (a support/compat/baseline section, or a reference table stating Baseline / Shipped-in / standards positions) — accurate messaging, not implied support.
Built reference includes a usable example surface (<pre> code and/or a live embed).
Code/IDL examples are correctly escaped (no attribute/element injection, invariant #4) and trace to the cited spec/IDL — no invented members (source review).

Embedded live example points at THIS feature's chrome-platform-showcase route (chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v151/textstream-for-response-request-blob...) — the canonical demo identity, never repointed.

The embedded chrome-platform-showcase demo actually renders (not a blank box or error frame); its platform behavior is governed by the CPS conformance contract referenced in cpsFeature, not re-asserted here.
The three stable member reference routes (Response/Request/Blob .textStream()) resolve with HTTP 200 on this origin.
assertions.test: (async () => { const rs = await Promise.all(["response/textstream","request/textstream","blob/textstream"].map(m => fetch('./' + m + '/'))); return rs.every(r => r.status === 200); })()

assertions.describe: Each member reference page renders all nine implementation dimensions (syntax, inputs, outputs, errors, context, lifecycle, examples, compatibility, security/privacy) with substantive text (40+ chars).
assertions.test: (async () => { const dims = ["syntax","inputs","outputs","errors","context","lifecycle","examples","compatibility","security-privacy"]; for (const m of ["response/textstream","request/textstream","blob/textstream"]) { const html = await (await fetch('./' + m + '/')).text(); const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html'); for (const d of dims) { const el = doc.getElementById(d); if (!el || el.parentElement.textContent.trim().length < 40) return false; } } return true; })()

assertions.describe: The feature overview links every inventory member route (implementation-sufficiency: overview explains the model and links every item).

Null-body lifecycle matches WPT: bodyUsed stays false after repeated textStream() calls, each call returns a distinct closed stream yielding zero chunks; immediate-consumption/single-use (bodyUsed -> true synchronously, TypeError on reuse) applies only to non-null bodies. Requires a Chrome 151+ runtime to execute (local Chrome 150 lacks the binding).

Blob.textStream() error contract matches FileAPI: exactly five failure reasons (NotFound, UnsafeFile, TooManyReads, SnapshotState, FileLock) error the stream with the raw failure reason (read() rejects), distinct from the FileReader DOMException-name mapping. Requires a Chrome 151+ runtime to execute (local Chrome 150 lacks the binding).

Compatibility evidence stays separated: support rows cite BCD files; vendor signals cite the ChromeStatus API feature record; no page in the feature tree cites core_enums.py for per-feature vendor views.
assertions.test: (async () => { for (const p of ["","response/textstream/","request/textstream/","blob/textstream/"]) { const html = await (await fetch('./' + p)).text(); if (!html.includes('chromestatus.com/api/v0/features/5146752165478400')) return false; if (html.includes('core_enums.py')) return false; if (!html.includes('browser-compat-data/blob/main/api/')) return false; } return true; })()

assertions.describe: Each member page's compatibility table renders inside an overflow-x container and every one of the nine dimension sections carries substantive text (structural proxy for readable rendering at both device classes).
assertions.test: (async () => { for (const p of ["response/textstream/","request/textstream/","blob/textstream/"]) { const html = await (await fetch('./' + p)).text(); const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html'); const table = doc.querySelector('.compat-table'); if (!table || !table.closest('.table-wrap')) return false; for (const d of ['syntax','inputs','outputs','errors','context','lifecycle','examples','compatibility','security-privacy']) { const el = doc.getElementById(d); if (!el || el.parentElement.textContent.trim().length < 40) return false; } } return true; })()
